title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 26: the word in the temple court, the demand for Jeremiah's death, and the elders who remembered Micah and Uriah.

questions.text: In the reign of which king did this word come from Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The word came from Yahweh in the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

answers.text: Jehoiakim the son of Josiah
Zedekiah king of Judah
Hezekiah king of Judah
Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim

questions.text: Where was Jeremiah told to stand and speak all the words Yahweh commanded him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told him to stand in the court of Yahweh's house and speak to all the cities of Judah which come to worship there, and not to omit a word.

answers.text: At the gate of the king's house
On the hills of Ephraim
In the court of Yahweh's house
In the valley of the dead bodies

questions.text: What did Yahweh say He would make this house like, if they would not listen?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that if they would not listen and walk in his law, He would make this house like Shiloh and make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

answers.text: Like Sodom
Like Shiloh
Like Samaria
Like Babylon

questions.text: What did the priests, the prophets and all the people do when Jeremiah had finished speaking?
questions.explanation: When he had finished speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, "You shall surely die!"

answers.text: They tore their clothes and wept
They asked him to pray for the city
They went each to his own house
They seized him and said he must surely die

questions.text: What did Jeremiah tell them to do, so that Yahweh would relent from the evil pronounced against them?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said, "Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey Yahweh your God's voice; then Yahweh will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you."

answers.text: Amend their ways and obey Yahweh's voice
Send gifts to the house of the king
Serve the king of Babylon seventy years
Drive out the prophets who spoke lies

questions.text: What did Jeremiah warn would happen to them if they put him to death?
questions.explanation: He said that if they put him to death they would bring innocent blood on themselves, on the city and on its inhabitants, for in truth Yahweh had sent him to speak these words.

answers.text: The temple would be burned that very year
The king of Judah would die in Babylon that year
They would bring innocent blood on themselves and on the city
No prophet would ever be sent to them again

questions.text: What did the princes and all the people then say to the priests and the prophets about Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: They said, "This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahweh our God."

answers.text: That he should be put in the stocks
That this man was not worthy of death
That he should be sent away to Egypt
That the priests should judge him

questions.text: Which earlier prophet did the elders of the land recall, who prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah?
questions.explanation: The elders recalled that Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, saying that Zion would be plowed as a field and Jerusalem would become heaps.

answers.text: Uriah the son of Shemaiah
Hananiah the son of Azzur
Shemaiah the Nehelamite
Micah the Morashtite

questions.text: Which prophet fled to Egypt, was fetched back, and was killed with the sword by Jehoiakim?
questions.explanation: Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim prophesied against this city; he fled to Egypt, but men were sent to fetch him back to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword.

answers.text: Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim
Elnathan the son of Achbor
Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah
Gemariah the son of Hilkiah

questions.text: Whose hand was with Jeremiah, so that he was not given into the hand of the people to be put to death?
questions.explanation: The hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they did not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

answers.text: Elnathan the son of Achbor
Micah the Morashtite
Ahikam the son of Shaphan
Uriah the son of Shemaiah
